notes.title: Cybernoir w Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[p]We’re excited to announce that [b]Cybernoir[/b] will be part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]!
During the festival, you’ll be able to dive into the neon-lit streets and get your first hands-on experience with the game.[/p][p]The free demo will let you:[/p][list][*][p]Test the [b]core gameplay mechanics[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Take on [b]sample missions and side activities[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Explore a slice of the [b]dark, crime-ridden city[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Get a feel for the [b]atmosphere and style[/b] of Cybernoir[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning of your journey into the world of [b]Cybernoir[/b] — the full story, choices, and challenges await in the full game.[/p][p]Mark your calendars, join the festival, and don’t miss your chance to step into the shadows![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="sZ1-sPaObc4;full"][/previewyoutube]
